What CloudCo assumes Cypher does: Organisation-wide CloudTrail with log file validation
Why: One single-region trail in one of three accounts, validation off. The CUEC's two words, 'organisation-wide' and 'validation', are both absent.

What CloudCo assumes Cypher does: MFA on the root account and restricted root use
Verdict: PARTLY PERFORMED - counts as NOT PERFORMED
Why: MFA exists, so half the CUEC is met. Restricted use is not: four undocumented root sign-ins in 90 days, no alert. A CUEC is met only when all of it is met.
Full administrator ('*:*') for every engineer and a forgotten contractor. 'Periodic review' is manual: zero privileged access reviews have ever been performed (OFI-15).
Data is encrypted, but only with CloudCo-managed keys. 'Management' means Cypher controls who can decrypt; no customer-managed key exists, so nothing is managed.
